sources.title: muradil211/AetherSearch · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: AetherSearch AetherSearch is a search-augmented language model release trained through a multi-stage post-training pipeline with SFT, DPO, and reinforcement learning. The released weights are provided in Hugging Face Transformers format and can be loaded with AutoModelForCausalLM and AutoTokenizer.

sources.snippet: AetherSearch is a 3B agentic search model trained through full-trajectory SFT, preference optimization with DPO, and information-gain-guided Agentic RL to learn effective multi-turn retrieval and reasoning.
